content: Repo: https://github.com/sebastbernal2-ship-it/gqh-delivery-gap (public, main). Single source of truth for the GQH 2026 systematic trading entry. Owners: docs/00-brief.md holds the track facts and rubric; docs/01-idea.md the delivery-gap strategy; docs/02-system.md the execution plan; docs/03-decisions.md the append-only decision ledger; docs/04-memory.md the memory protocol; docs/reviews/ the team critiques; results/README.md the frozen artifact envelope (e1.json, e2.json, e3.json, e4.json, costs.json); OWNERS.md the one-writer-per-path map. Session start: make sync, which pulls and absorbs the team's shared memory, then read docs/00 through 03. Write a shareable memory with: make remember M=... (tags it gqh). Share it with: make share, which filters and writes memory/SHARED.md and memory/shared.json. Gates: make test, make secrets, make check.

Do not load memory/shared.json with hippo import --file: it parses the JSON as plain text and writes one memory per line, flooding the store with fragment entries such as a bare key string. Use scripts/memory_absorb.py, which compares normalized content against the local export and calls hippo remember once per missing entry. It is idempotent.
